cards.card_text: Nahor's wife Milcah (Genesis 11:29) has borne him eight sons, and his concubine Reumah bears him four more children.
cards.verse_text: Moreover, Nahor’s concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
cards.snippet: Moreover, Nahor’s concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

cards.card_text: While he's living there, his son Reuben sleeps with his father's concubine Bilhah.
cards.verse_text: While Israel was living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it.
cards.snippet: …living in that region, Reuben went in and slept with his father’s concubine Bilhah, and Israel heard about it.

cards.card_text: One standout: Timna, a concubine of Esau's son Eliphaz, gives birth to Amalek.
cards.verse_text: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek.
cards.snippet: Additionally, Timna, a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, gave birth to Amalek.

cards.card_text: Gideon's concubine, who lives in Shechem, also has a son, and Gideon names him Abimelech.
cards.verse_text: His concubine, who dwelt in Shechem, also bore him a son, and he named him Abimelech.

cards.card_text: A Levite living way out in the remote hill country of Ephraim takes a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
cards.verse_text: Now in those days, when there was no king in Israel, a Levite who lived in the remote hill country of Ephraim took for himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.
cards.snippet: …lived in the remote hill country of Ephraim took for himself a concubine from Bethlehem in Judah.

cards.verse_text: He got up and departed, and arrived opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.
cards.snippet: …opposite Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), with his two saddled donkeys and his concubine.

cards.card_text: Then the old man says, "Look, let me bring out my virgin daughter and the man's concubine, and you can use them and do with them as you wish.
cards.verse_text: Look, let me bring out my virgin daughter and the man’s concubine, and you can use them and do with them as you wish.
cards.snippet: Look, let me bring out my virgin daughter and the man’s concubine, and you can use them and do with them as you wish.

cards.card_text: So the Levite takes his concubine and sends her outside to them.
cards.verse_text: So the Levite took his concubine and sent her outside to them, and they raped her and abused her throughout the night, and at dawn they let her go.

cards.card_text: Then he says they abused his concubine, and she died.
cards.verse_text: They intended to kill me, but they abused my concubine, and she died.
cards.snippet: They intended to kill me, but they abused my concubine, and she died.

cards.card_text: The Levite says he cut his concubine into pieces and sent her throughout Israel.
cards.verse_text: Then I took my concubine, cut her into pieces, and sent her throughout the land of Israel’s inheritance, because they had committed a lewd and disgraceful act in Israel.

cards.card_text: Then Ish-bosheth questions Abner about Saul's concubine Rizpah: "Why did you sleep with my father's concubine?"
cards.verse_text: Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah.
cards.snippet: Now Saul had a concubine named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah.

cards.card_text: After arriving from Hebron, David takes more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters are born to him.
cards.verse_text: After he had arrived from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.

cards.card_text: David's household goes with him, but he leaves ten concubines behind to take care of the ___.
cards.verse_text: But he left behind ten concubines to take care of the palace.
cards.snippet: But he left behind ten concubines to take care of the palace.

cards.card_text: What should we do?" Ahithophel tells him to sleep with his father's concubines, the ones David left to take care of the palace.
cards.verse_text: What should we do?” Ahithophel replied, “Sleep with your father’s concubines, whom he has left to take care of the palace.
cards.snippet: What should we do?” Ahithophel replied, “Sleep with your father’s concubines, whom he has left to take care of the palace.

cards.card_text: And he sleeps with his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.
cards.verse_text: So they pitched a tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.
cards.snippet: …tent for Absalom on the roof, and he slept with his father’s concubines in the sight of all Israel.

cards.card_text: Back at his palace in Jerusalem, David puts the ten concubines he left to take care of the palace in a house under guard.
cards.verse_text: When David returned to his palace in Jerusalem, he took the ten concubines he had left to take care of the palace, and he placed them in a house under guard.

cards.card_text: Word of what Saul's concubine Rizpah has done reaches David.
cards.verse_text: When David was told what Saul’s concubine Rizpah, daughter of Aiah, had done,

cards.card_text: Now the numbers: seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines.
cards.verse_text: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines—and his wives turned his heart away.
cards.snippet: He had seven hundred wives of royal birth and three hundred concubines—and his wives turned his heart away.

cards.card_text: Abraham's son Ishmael has twelve sons, starting with his firstborn, Nebaioth, then Kedar, and Keturah, Abraham's concubine, has six more sons, Midian among them.
cards.verse_text: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
cards.snippet: The sons born to Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

cards.card_text: Then nine MORE sons, not counting the sons by his concubines, and two of them are named Eliphelet, so I bet calling those boys in from outside got confusing real quick.
cards.verse_text: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines.
cards.snippet: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines.

cards.card_text: Then comes Rehoboam's family: in all, eighteen wives, sixty concubines, twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
cards.verse_text: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and concubines.
cards.snippet: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his wives and concubines.

cards.card_text: In the morning she goes to a second harem, under Shaashgaz, the king's eunuch in charge of the concubines.
cards.verse_text: She would go there in the evening, and in the morning she would return to a second harem under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines.
cards.snippet: …under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines.

cards.card_text: So he expands his pursuits: houses, vineyards, gardens and parks, reservoirs, servants, herds and flocks, silver and gold, singers and many concubines.
cards.verse_text: I gathered to myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men—many concubines.
cards.snippet: …male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men—many concubines.

cards.card_text: Now he brings up a crowd: sixty queens, eighty concubines and maidens without number.
cards.verse_text: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and maidens without number,
cards.snippet: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and maidens without number,

cards.card_text: But next to all those queens, concubines and maidens, his dove, his perfect one, is ___.
cards.verse_text: The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.
cards.snippet: The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.

cards.card_text: Now the maidens, the queens and the concubines all get a look at his dove.
cards.verse_text: The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.
cards.snippet: The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.

cards.card_text: Like the maidens, the queens and concubines praise the man's dove when they see her.
cards.verse_text: The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.
cards.snippet: The maidens see her and call her blessed; the queens and concubines sing her praises.

cards.card_text: The king drinks from them with his nobles, his wives and his concubines.
cards.verse_text: Thus they brought in the gold vessels that had been taken from the temple, the house of God in Jerusalem, and the king drank from them, along with his nobles, his wives, and his concubines.
cards.snippet: …king drank from them, along with his nobles, his wives, and his concubines.
